$comment: Contract C1: every DEVPORTAL_* setting with its default. The defaults live in sefaria/settings.py before the local-settings import, and are repeated in devportal/dev/settings_standalone.py. Change only through the Integrator (PLAN.md §4.3).

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_API_ORIGIN
settings.description: Origin of the Sefaria API. Try It and the code samples call it; it is the CSP connect-src entry for the API; the MCP execute-request tool accepts only this host. Has no visitor-facing input.

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_GA4
settings.description: GA4 measurement ids by section, e.g. {"default": "G-6SXQFSB219", "gallery": "G-44RHV2ZWQ1"}. Empty (the default outside production) loads no analytics.

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_DEMO_API_KEY
settings.description: Public demo API key. Empty: Try It sends no key and code samples contain none, exactly as live. Set: Try It sends X-API-Key and the samples include it (PLAN.md §2.12).

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_MEDIA_BUCKET
settings.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket for editor uploads and mirrored images (prefix developers/). Empty means SITE_SETTINGS["TOPICS_BUCKET"] (I-11, H-4).

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_ALLOW_INDEXING
settings.description: robots.txt serves live's content when true (production; the inverse of nginx.disableScraping) and 'Disallow: /' otherwise.

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_ALLOW_README_IMAGES
settings.description: Adds https://files.readme.io to the CSP img-src so imported pages show their images until devportal_mirror_images has run. Cutover requires false (PLAN.md §8.2).

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_AUTO_SEED
settings.description: The post_migrate receiver imports the vendored content snapshot, syncs the spec and rebuilds when either hash differs from PortalState (PLAN.md §7.6). Forced false under pytest by devportal/tests/conftest.py. Set false in production after cutover.

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_CUTOVER_DONE
settings.description: True once developers.sefaria.org is served from here. The main site's poweredByURL prop becomes <developersURL>/powered-by (PLAN.md §2.2, Q2).

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_VITE_DEV_SERVER
settings.description: Local development only, e.g. "http://localhost:5173". When set, {% devportal_entry %} emits the Vite dev client instead of the built bundle, and the CSP allows that origin (C10 dev_only).

settings.name: DEVPORTAL_TRUST_GATEWAY_CLIENT_IP
settings.description: When true, per-visitor rate limits (feedback, MCP, 404 log) take the client address from the gateway's X-Original-Forwarded-For header instead of REMOTE_ADDR (the proxy). Helm sets it from gateway.enabled. Never enable it without that gateway in front: the header would be client-controlled.

standalone_only.name: DEVPORTAL_STANDALONE_POWERED_BY_FIXTURE
standalone_only.description: The JSON file that answers GET /api/powered-by on the standalone dev server. A missing file answers {"projects": []}.

standalone_only.name: DEVPORTAL_SQLITE_PATH
standalone_only.description: SQLite database of the standalone dev server.
